readme: TG-477 (epic TG-114 C-8): the distillation manifest for the FIRST prose-distillation batch — the
predecessor's skill library, re-authored per ADR-0012 into skills/<class>/<name>/SKILL.md drafts.
THIS FILE IS THE INVENTORY TRUTH. The plan said 'the predecessor's 12 skills'; what is actually on
disk is 24 SKILL.md prose sources (9 packaged skills + 15 shell-skill prose files) plus 2 script-only
skill directories that carry no prose. Every one of the 26 appears below with a disposition:
distilled — re-authored into tools/prosedistill/distilled/<target_name>.md and composed into the
skills/ tree by tools/prosedistill (13: 10 class=skill + 3 class=runbook);
merged    — its distinct judgment was folded into another entry's distilled target (3);
skipped   — not distilled, with the reason (10). The dominant skip reason is honesty about
duplication: TG already re-authored several of these protocols into the live compiled
seed library (agent/skills/seeds/, TG-471) — minting a second draft of a live protocol
would create exactly the two-sources drift ADR-0017 exists to prevent.
Auxiliary source files (alert-status/COMMANDS.md, drift-check/CHECKS.md, cost-report/QUERIES.sql and
every *.sh) are estate command/query sheets: ADR-0012 strips bundled executables categorically —
their durable judgment, where any exists, was captured via the owning SKILL.md entry below.
source_path is RELATIVE to the predecessor checkout root (the tool's --source-root flag) so no
machine-local absolute path is ever committed. Seeding these drafts into the skill store is
DELIBERATELY NOT part of this batch — see the doc comment in main.go.
BATCHES 2+3 (TG-478 + TG-479, appended 2026-08-14). Batch 2 is the predecessor's specialist agent
definitions (.claude/agents/ — 11 on disk, matching the plan's 11): 5 distilled (1 skill + 4
runbook), 1 merged, 5 skipped. The dominant skip reason is domain: four specialists are software-
development seats (CI debugging, code exploration/review, cross-repo impact) — TG's agent decision
path is estate triage, not software development — and one charters the predecessor's operator-
education module, a plane TG does not have. Batch 3 is the predecessor's runbook corpus
(docs/runbooks/ — 30 prose files on disk, matching the plan's 30): 14 distilled (1 skill + 13
runbook), 6 merged, 10 skipped. Skips split three ways: safety/trial governance that in TG is CODE
(the op-class registry, mode chokepoint, flywheel eval gate) and which ADR-0017 keeps out of the
store plane by absence; software-development orchestration (parallel dev, project bootstrap, spec
lint, repo onboarding) outside TG's domain; and one-off repo-state or dev-host janitor docs with no
durable estate judgment. wiki/operations/runbooks.md was inspected and is NOT a distinct source —
it is a generated compilation of the openclaw skill files batch 1 already inventoried.
BATCH 4 (TG-85, epic TG-78, appended 2026-08-19): the Cisco IOS/ASA triage command-layer pack — 6
distilled runbook entries. UNLIKE batches 1-3, these are NOT ported from predecessor prose (the
predecessor's Cisco prose corpus — cisco-asa-specialist, tunnel-failover — is already fully
inventoried above); source_path departs from 'relative to the predecessor checkout root' and instead
names the primary Cisco vendor documentation page each entry is grounded in, per entry's own notes
field and each artifact's own Doc basis section. Companion to firewall-triage-patterns (batch 2's
judgment layer distilled from cisco-asa-specialist): that pack covers which cause to suspect first;
this batch covers the exact show/debug commands, output interpretation, and remediation.
BATCH 5 (TG-78, appended 2026-08-19): the Kubernetes triage command-layer pack — 6 distilled
runbook entries, same shape as batch 4: NOT ported from predecessor prose; source_path names the
primary kubernetes.io reference per entry, and each artifact's own Doc basis section lists every
page grounding a specific command or claim. Distinct from k8s-alert-vetting (batch 2, the
k8s-diagnostician judgment layer: which alert to trust, when to suspect the dependency layer
below) and the live compiled seed k8s-triage.md (fix-shape lanes): this batch is the COMMAND
layer underneath both — the exact kubectl/crictl/etcdctl to run per failure class (pod
crashloop/OOMKilled, pod pending/scheduling, node NotReady/kubelet, PVC/StorageClass binding,
Service/Ingress/CoreDNS, control-plane apiserver/etcd degradation), how to read the output, and
the remediation. Tool-gated like every other runbook-class K8s entry in this manifest (ADR-0012):
TG has no Kubernetes read tool wired into the agent's own tool registry —
modules/actuation/kubernetes exists as a declared-but-disabled reference actuation module (Phase
0/1, a deniedRunner, no execution path; modules/bootstrap/bootstrap.go) — so this batch is
advisory knowledge-library content until a vendor-official, read-only cluster surface is wired
behind the interceptor.

entries.description: Review the whole active alert queue before any single-alert deep dive — age, staleness, flapping, and incident grouping
entries.notes: COMMANDS.md (8 estate data-source commands) stripped; the queue-review judgment generalizes onto get-active-alerts.

entries.description: The phase map of an alert-triggered incident session — entry question and exit criterion per phase, no phase skipped
entries.notes: Runbook class — a process map, not one behavioral unit. Its embedded behavioral protocols (debugging protocol, proving-your-work, shortcuts-to-resist, loop red-flags) already live as TG compiled seeds (agent/skills/seeds/, TG-471) and are deliberately NOT re-drafted here.

Duplicative of the live compiled seed agent/skills/seeds/conservative-remediation.md (TG-471): the situation-to-conservative-reversible-action judgment is already TG-authored and agent-loaded. A second draft of a live protocol is the two-sources drift ADR-0017 forbids. The source's auto-execute authority claims are the predecessor's control shape; in TG that authority lives in the op-class registry and the mode chokepoint, never in prose.

entries.description: Periodic model-spend and session-quality review — category thresholds, variant comparison, trend, low-confidence sessions
entries.notes: Runbook class — operator-facing review knowledge, not agent loop competence. QUERIES.sql (predecessor SQLite schema) stripped; thresholds and anomaly judgment re-authored generically.

entries.description: Compare declared configuration against running state, report drift per surface, and let drift reshape the fix
entries.notes: CHECKS.md (4 estate check commands) stripped; declared-vs-running judgment re-authored onto TG reads plus a generic configuration source of truth.

entries.description: Find conditions degrading but not yet alerting, surface each once, and route findings by reversibility
entries.notes: The richer v2 of the pre-alert discovery pair; openclaw/skills/proactive-scan/SKILL.md merges into this target. Routing authority is re-authored to TG law — reversible findings become PROPOSALS through the governed gate; prose never authorizes actuation.

Obsolete for TG: charters a roster of the predecessor's eleven sub-agents — an architecture TG does not have (single governed loop with typed dispatch, INV-08). The residual idea (declare the investigation plan up front, advisory not mandatory) is too thin to stand alone and its TG surface (session trajectory) already exists.

Duplicative of the live compiled seed agent/skills/seeds/triage-protocol.md (TG-471), which is the TG re-authoring of this protocol onto the real tool vocabulary. Its remaining mechanics are TG-native systems already: evidence citation is proving-your-work, precedent consult is the precedent-recall target, typed confidence is core code.

Estate tool wrapper (drives a predecessor compiler script) with no durable decision content beyond run-and-report. TG's knowledge-library plane is its own epic item (ADR-0017 runbook class); nothing here survives re-authoring.
Script-only skill directory — no SKILL.md prose exists to distill; ADR-0012 strips bundled executables categorically.

Out of TG's domain: code-graph queries over the predecessor's development repositories. TG's agent decision path is estate triage, not software development; no TG tool exists or is planned on this surface.

entries.description: Treat simultaneous multi-host alerts as one event — master plus children, a correlation verdict, one escalation
entries.notes: Ticket-system plumbing stripped; the master-child grouping and shared-upstream correlation judgment re-authored onto get-estate-context topology.

entries.description: Review another analysis by independently re-verifying claims — five checks, then an evidence-bound verdict
entries.notes: The gateway wire format and dev-task variant stripped; the five-check verification discipline and verdict vocabulary kept whole.

entries.description: When an investigation fails mid-flight, hand the next tier resumable structured context instead of a restart
entries.notes: Estate example block stripped; the handoff structure and the failure-as-evidence judgment kept.

entries.description: Escalate implementation and mutation work, answer information questions yourself from the source of truth
entries.notes: Webhook/session plumbing stripped. openclaw/skills/youtrack-lookup/SKILL.md merges into this target — its lookup-not-escalation boundary and never-answer-from-memory rules are the same judgment from the other side.

Deliberately NOT distilled as content: a prose blocked-command list is the predecessor's safety shape. In TG the blocked-action floor is code — the fail-closed interceptor, the op-class registry, and the never-auto floor — and ADR-0017 rules that safety prose never enters the store plane at all (enforced by absence). Landing it as store-bound draft content would invert that ruling.

entries.description: One incident per fault — reuse open incidents, reopen ones under verification, link related, escalate recurrence
entries.notes: The pipeline choreography (ticket creation, webhook callbacks, custom fields) is estate plumbing and stripped; the dedup windows, reuse/reopen rules and recurrence-escalation judgment are the distilled content. The investigation protocol itself is the live seed triage-protocol.md, not re-drafted here.

Duplicative of the live compiled seed agent/skills/seeds/k8s-triage.md (TG-471). Also tool-gated by ADR-0012: no further Kubernetes skill content until a vendor-official read-only tool surface is wired behind the interceptor.
Script-only skill directory — no SKILL.md prose exists to distill; ADR-0012 strips bundled executables categorically.

entries.description: Consult precedent before diagnosing, weigh it against live evidence, and treat empty history as a finding
entries.notes: openclaw/skills/playbook-lookup/SKILL.md merges into this target — own-outcome recall and incident-playbook lookup collapse onto TG's one precedent surface (get-incident-history).

entries.description: Resolve what the target IS from the source of truth before diagnosing it, and stop on identity mismatch
entries.notes: The predecessor's CMDB subcommand sheet stripped; the identity-before-diagnosis ordering and mismatch-stop judgment re-authored onto get-estate-context.

Estate-only: node RAM sizes, hypervisor quirks, cluster rosters and access paths. ADR-0012 is explicit that estate specifics belong in the estate graph and configuration, not in prose; TG serves this via get-estate-context.

Merged into precedent-recall: past-resolution lookup by host, rule, or incident id is the same competence as own-outcome recall on TG's single precedent surface; its present-the-id-date-confidence and say-when-empty rules are carried in that target.

Merged into amber-zone-discovery: the v1 check table (disk, certificate expiry, stale work items) folds into the v2 amber-band set; the surface-vs-act split is superseded by the v2 reversibility routing.

entries.description: Triage a scanner finding by identity, novelty against baseline, and exposure — deep verification is escalated
entries.notes: Runbook class, tool-gated: TG has no security-scanner read tools wired, so this lands as knowledge-library content; per ADR-0012 a skill-class version waits for a vendor-official read-only tool surface. Scanner host mapping and addresses stripped.

Merged into escalation-boundary: the lookup-vs-escalation boundary and the run-the-read-never-answer-from-memory rule are the same judgment stated from the information side; tracker command mechanics are estate plumbing.

Out of TG's domain: a software-development seat (CI pipeline failure diagnosis for the predecessor's product repos). TG's agent decision path is estate triage, not software development — the same boundary as batch 1's codegraph-lookup skip. Its flake-vs-regression judgment stays with the dev tooling.

entries.description: Perimeter-firewall triage judgment — uplink first on multi-site bursts, reboot-window awareness, protection-state cleanup, delete-then-recreate on stateful config
entries.notes: Runbook class, tool-gated: high-risk network CLIs are re-author-only per ADR-0012 and TG has no firewall tools wired. Device inventory, addresses, provider names, command sheets and legacy-cipher access recipes stripped; the durable judgment (shared-uplink-first ordering, watchdog-reboot windows, post-recovery protection-state cleanup, delete-then-recreate on stateful config, device-is-truth sync direction) re-authored generically.
Out of TG's domain: codebase research for the predecessor's development repos — the same boundary as batch 1's codegraph-lookup skip. No TG surface exists or is planned.

Out of TG's domain: source-code review for the predecessor's development repos. Its one transferable idea — fresh-eyes review in a separate context with severity-ranked, evidence-cited findings — already lands in batch 1's independent-review target; the rest is dev-convention checklists.
Out of TG's domain: cross-repo refactoring impact analysis for the predecessor's development monorepo. No TG surface; the leaves-first change-ordering judgment is dev-workflow content.

entries.description: Vet a Kubernetes alert against known recurring patterns and live cluster state before treating it as novel — the dependency layer below may own the fault
entries.notes: Runbook class, tool-gated (ADR-0012: no k8s skill until a vendor-official read-only tool surface is wired). Distinct from the live seed k8s-triage.md, which owns fix-shape lanes; this target owns alert VETTING — known-false-positive matching with confirmation, live-cluster-over-monitor liveness, storage-latency-to-control-plane cascade, drain gating. Cluster rosters, addresses and per-cluster known-issue rows stripped.

entries.description: The escalated tier a security finding hands into — verify exposure from an untrusted vantage, enrich with threat context, size blast radius, time-box remediation
entries.notes: Runbook class, tool-gated (no scanner, threat-intel or perimeter-ACL read tools wired). The complement of batch 1's security-finding-triage: that target is the triage seat which ESCALATES deep verification; this is the receiving protocol. Scanner topology, addresses and vendor endpoints stripped; the untrusted-vantage exposure rule, severity-moves-both-ways reasoning, audit-before-mass-delete and live-config-is-truth kept.

entries.description: Storage-incident judgment — no reboots to clear alerts, trajectory-graded capacity, observed replication before any drain, cascade-aware fix ordering
entries.notes: Runbook class, tool-gated: storage-vendor CLIs are not TG tools; check-host-disk covers guest filesystems only. Host inventory, NAS models and command sheets stripped; the reboot-cascade prohibition, vendor-panel-vs-host cross-check, days-until-full trajectory grading, observed-replication-before-drain and dependency-ordered fixes re-authored generically.

Role definition for the predecessor's operator-education module — a plane TG does not have. Its load-bearing invariant (every factual claim cites a verbatim source; refuse rather than invent) is TG's live proving-your-work seed already; the rest is curriculum/quiz plumbing.

entries.description: Gather structured facts for a decision without proposing — trust-ranked sources, full target names, alert vetting, and an obstacles section for what could not be observed
entries.notes: The predecessor's dispatch framing, host inventory, log-query sheets and diary plumbing stripped. The facts-not-fixes seat, the liveness-ranked source hierarchy for state questions (complementing identity-first-lookup's identity split), site-qualified naming, flap/maintenance vetting and the obstacles-section duty re-authored onto TG reads.

Merged into live-workflow-edit-safety: its validate-before-deploy sequence, exactly-one-top-level-return rule and known-footgun checklist are the same judgment as the source runbook behind that target (the same founding outage), stated as a role; the platform-version-specific node checks and credential-id pins are estate plumbing.

entries.description: Follow one incident through every pipeline stage by a shared key — per-stage green is not chain health, and fixes are proven end-to-end
entries.notes: The predecessor's stage names, workflow ids and store queries stripped. Kept whole: a chain dark for months across layers while each stage passed alone; one incident-keyed query walking the whole chain; symptom-to-owning-stage red-flag tables; freshness over row-existence; prove fixes end-to-end, never at their own stage.

Merged into knowledge-base-hygiene: its durable judgment — discount lower-trust capture at retrieval rather than exclude, skip below-substance captures, roll back by retrieval suppression before deletion, never hand-edit machine-extracted rows — is that target's weighting and rollback rule set. The chunking/embedding/cron mechanics are predecessor plumbing.

Merged into fault-injection-exercise: contributes multi-fault sequencing with cooldowns, the operator-attended rule for the widest scenarios, pre-declared maintenance state plus notification, phased priority-ordered recovery, and the fixed-window post-mortem landing where precedent lookup finds it. Scenario scripts and site specifics stripped.

Development-host build-artifact janitor (worktree/target-dir sweeper). Out of TG's domain; its careful bits (active-use detection before deletion, dry-run first, derived-artifacts-need-no-rollback) are dev-tooling judgment, not estate triage.

A dated, one-off reconciliation plan for the predecessor's live working tree (branch-behind-main accounting, which local commits to preserve). Repo-state hygiene for one specific checkout, not durable estate judgment; TG's own tree discipline is session law, not store content.

Merged into fault-injection-exercise: contributes the one-redundant-leg-at-a-time constraint, the fragile-system exclusion list, and the crash-loop check (restart counts as an instrument) before an exercise closes — the restart-count rule also surfaces in recovery-revalidation. Container inventories and endpoints stripped.

Merged into platform-self-healing: the dead-man judgment — heartbeat emitted on every exit path, absent()-guarded staleness so no-data pages, state recorded as found before healing, prove-the-alert-fires drills — is carried whole in that target; in the predecessor's own history this watchdog was consolidated into the platform controller. Metric names and host paths stripped.

entries.description: Decide DOWN vs ISOLATED when the telemetry path itself failed — two-sided probes, multi-anchor evidence, and out-of-band reporting
entries.notes: Born from a real mis-triage: a primary-WAN loss severed the tunnel mesh, the site stayed alive on a backup uplink, and from outside it read as needs-physical-access. Provider names, addresses, SMS plumbing and host specifics stripped; the isolated-vs-dark discrimination, distinct-device anchor spread, confirm windows, structural-gap honesty and the single-observer weakness kept.

entries.description: Operate a learned causal dependency graph — visible staleness, capped mined confidence, fail-open advisory vs fail-closed actuation, mechanical adjudication
entries.notes: The predecessor's graph implementation (tables, query CLI, crons, phase plan) stripped. The invariants kept whole: self-expiring learned edges that degrade visibly; mined-confidence caps below suppression/actuation eligibility; advisory-fails-open vs actuation-fails-closed with no remediation-without-predictions; verdicts only from mechanical adjudication; resolver-before-write; coverage grown via authoritative sources in ROI order.

Merged into fault-injection-exercise: contributes the degradation-vs-outage fault class, protocol-timer reasoning (hold timers absorb injected latency), the DEGRADED-acceptable grade for stress scenarios, and post-exercise cleanup verification. Injection command sheets and provider tables stripped.

entries.description: Periodic knowledge-base review — cluster and expire by durability class, weight lower-trust capture at retrieval, never auto-delete
entries.notes: Runbook class — operator review knowledge, like batch 1's cost-review. Embedding backend and paths stripped. Kept: report-proposes-review-disposes; identity-not-body clustering; durable-guidance never expires while snapshots do; no cross-durability merges; automate the cadence only after manual rounds prove signal quality. cli-session-rag-capture merges its retrieval-weighting judgment here.

entries.description: The unskippable sequence for editing code inside a live automation platform — snapshot, validate, push, re-fetch, test-fire — because dead code still parses
entries.notes: Runbook class, tool-gated: TG has no workflow-platform write tools (and would not auto-edit one). The 14-hour-outage lesson kept whole: dead code is parsed code; the validator gates the push; re-fetch proves the platform stored what was sent; loud-failure floor. Platform node ids, API commands and version-pinned check rows stripped; workflow-validator (batch 2) merges here.
Software-development orchestration: greenfield project bootstrap for the predecessor's parallel-dev pipeline (spec interview, validator gates, slot onboarding). Out of TG's domain end to end.

entries.description: Rotate credentials without lockout — recovery path first, verify the new value before cutting consumers over, and a secret that touched history is burned
entries.notes: Runbook class — credential-plane operator knowledge; TG has no rotation tools wired. Product names, host ids and the leaked value's specifics stripped. Kept: the sole-admin unrecoverable-lockout rule (why that rotation is operator-coordinated, never automated), the staged set-verify-cut order, durable-config over one-shot mutation, per-consumer verification, and history-burns-the-secret.

entries.description: Config backups as independent tiers — live device outranks every copy, one writer per record path, and the dumb offline tier survives the clever one
entries.notes: Product and host names stripped. Kept: failure-independent tier layering; backup-never-authoritative (live device wins, disagreement is a drift finding for the record path); one-writer-per-record-path (the dual-push sync was retired precisely for conflicting commits); the deliberate dumbness of the survival tier; periodic keep-or-retire review with named triggers.

Software-development orchestration: dispatching parallel code workers, merge coordination, work-unit state machines. Out of TG's domain — TG's agent decision path is estate triage; TG's own MR/worktree discipline is session law, not store content.

entries.description: Govern the platform's own reconcile loop — heal Plane A only, idempotency-gated re-runs, heal caps that escalate, and a dead-man that outlives maintenance
entries.notes: Scheduler/job names and metric plumbing stripped. Kept whole: the two-plane boundary (heal the platform, never the mission — mission authority stays with the governed gates); idempotency safe-lists with escalate-on-unknown; cap-then-escalate, never thrash; maintenance suppresses heals but never the heartbeat; single-operator consolidation with visible retirement; ships-dark analysis-only default; honest oversight-vs-control wording. gateway-watchdog-deadman merges its dead-man judgment here.

entries.description: After any recovery, re-prove baseline layer by layer — own instrument per layer, suppression cleanup, polling-cycle patience, precedent-visible closure
entries.notes: Skill class: the ladder judgment generalizes onto TG reads (get-device-status, check-host-services, get-active-alerts, get-estate-context) and extends the prediction check TG's verifier owns. The predecessor's tunnel/routing/endpoint command sheets stripped; per-layer own-instrument checks, residue cleanup (suppression flags, protection state), lingering-alert patience and stuck-state descent kept.

Deliberately NOT distilled as prose: candidate-trial governance (control arms, minimum samples, significance bars, promote-only-on-win) is CODE in TG — the flywheel's eval A/B and class gates (ADR-0012's model-generated-skill rejection; TG-475's mechanism). A prose restatement in the store plane would drift against the enforced mechanism — the batch 1 exec-safety shape.

Predecessor-gateway plumbing: registering a new product repo into its dispatch (slot config, workflow dict mirrors, tracker project). Out of TG's domain; the mirrored-config-must-update-together caveat is carried by live-workflow-edit-safety's mirrored-sites rule.

Merged into external-visibility-triage: its durable judgment — a surviving fallback DOWNGRADES severity and must be stated with its measured quality cost; grade by residual capability, not component state — is that target's fallback rule. The GPU service's restart/cache/contention command sheet is estate plumbing and stripped.

Deliberately NOT distilled: the predecessor's risk-band/approval architecture (bands, never-auto floor, sentinel kill-switches, vote ledger) is the control shape that in TG is CODE — the risk classifier, op-class registry, mode chokepoint and never-auto floor — and ADR-0017 rules safety prose out of the store plane (enforced by absence), exactly the batch 1 exec-safety ruling.

entries.description: Suppress intentional scheduled events with a conjunctive safety floor — never critical, behavioral confirmation, strict windows, fail-open, suppress-then-verify
entries.notes: The predecessor's matcher implementation (tables, crons, metric names, debug ladder) stripped. The safety design kept whole: conjunctive guards each failing OPEN to escalate; never-suppress-critical; observe-before-live behavioral confirmation; host-local-timezone window math; off-schedule instances are real incidents; suppress-then-verify with force-reopen and paging; ships dark behind an operator control with instant kill.

entries.description: Intermittent success through a load balancer means diverged replicas — read each replica, find the stalled checkpoint, search for siblings, treat backfill as separate work
entries.notes: Runbook class, tool-gated (cluster/storage read tools). Vendor commands, cluster contexts and IaC variable mechanics stripped. Kept: per-replica reads over the balanced endpoint (the incident's second, hidden defect was found only this way); the recurring failure SHAPE (persisted checkpoint against a garbage-collected log) and the search-for-siblings duty; diagnose-before-fixing between look-alike modes; the forward-fix vs backfill separation.

Predecessor prose-library governance (semver bump rules for its skill files). TG's artifact versioning belongs to the store plane and its governed write path (ADR-0017; this pipeline stamps 0.1.0-distilled) — a second versioning law living in store prose would drift against the owning mechanism.

Per-check remediation sheet for the predecessor's project-bootstrap spec validator. Software-development tooling outside TG's domain; TG's spec lattice has its own gates and their documentation lives with them.

entries.description: A pipeline canary earns trust by structural isolation — throwaway state, per-stage assertions, and a leak metric proving the isolation itself
entries.notes: Script paths, stage names and metric plumbing stripped. Kept: structural isolation over behavioral promises (throwaway store, no real actuation, synthetic artifacts structurally unable to satisfy real gates); the leak metric as a paged top-severity signal; per-stage grading with earliest-failure ownership; staleness/absent alerting on the canary itself; disable-until-leak-zero on any isolation regression.
Operations runbook for the predecessor's operator-education module (crons, dashboards, operator lifecycle) — the module TG does not have; pairs with the batch 2 teacher-agent specialist skip.

entries.description: Deliberate fault injection with pre-verified backups, staged expectations, time-bound validation, dead-man rollback, and a blast-radius floor
entries.notes: Runbook class — drills are operator actuation, outside the agent's lane entirely. Tunnel inventories, device commands and provider names stripped. Kept: pre-verify the surviving path; written expected-behavior timelines; time-bound machine-checkable validation markers; recovery that clears protection-system grudges; dead-man auto-rollback; never touch the production-carrying transit layer. isp-degradation-response, combined-failure-response and dmz-container-recovery merge here.

entries.description: Triage outside-observer claims about reachability — independent vantages, instrument health, self-inflicted check, severity by remaining redundancy
entries.notes: Runbook class, tool-gated (no external-routing or internet-visibility tools wired). Autonomous-system numbers, prefixes, provider names and exporter paths stripped. Kept: independent-vantage confirmation before trusting one observer; instrument-health and data-source sanity (a dead source makes your alerts noise); the did-we-cause-this self-check; severity graded by remaining redundancy; absorption windows for known observer churn. rerank-service merges its fallback-cost severity rule here.

entries.description: Cisco IOS and ASA interface and line-protocol-down triage — read the status pair before believing a cable story, name the err-disable cause before clearing it
entries.notes: TG-85 (epic TG-78): newly authored content grounded directly in Cisco's own IOS/ASA documentation, NOT ported from predecessor prose — the predecessor's Cisco prose corpus is already fully accounted for elsewhere in this manifest (see cisco-asa-specialist, tunnel-failover). source_path names the primary vendor reference; the artifact's own Doc basis section lists every page grounding a specific command or claim. Covers interface/line-protocol-down and err-disable triage for both IOS and ASA; companion to firewall-triage-patterns (judgment layer) at the command layer.

entries.description: Cisco IOS and ASA ACL and NAT misconfiguration triage — hit counts over intuition, packet-tracer before touching a rule, implicit-deny and NAT-address gotchas
entries.notes: TG-85 (epic TG-78): newly authored, vendor-doc-grounded content, not predecessor-derived (see cisco-interface-line-protocol-triage's note on this manifest's provenance convention for this batch). Covers ACL and NAT misconfiguration triage on IOS and ASA, including packet-tracer as the decisive tool.

entries.notes: TG-85 (epic TG-78): newly authored, vendor-doc-grounded content, not predecessor-derived. Covers ASA site-to-site IPsec/IKEv2 tunnel-down triage at the command layer; firewall-triage-patterns (already in this manifest, distilled from cisco-asa-specialist) is the companion judgment layer this pack's delete-then-recreate and shun-table rules are consistent with.

entries.description: Cisco IOS and ASA BGP and OSPF adjacency-loss triage — read the neighbor state machine before guessing, MTU and timer mismatches over a fresh packet capture
entries.notes: TG-85 (epic TG-78): newly authored, vendor-doc-grounded content, not predecessor-derived. Covers BGP and OSPF adjacency-loss triage via the documented neighbor state machines on IOS and ASA routed mode.

entries.description: Cisco IOS and ASA high-CPU and memory triage — attribute to a process or flood before a reload, interrupt versus process load, known crypto and DoS culprits
entries.notes: TG-85 (epic TG-78): newly authored, vendor-doc-grounded content, not predecessor-derived. Covers high-CPU and memory triage on IOS and ASA, including the interrupt/process split and ASA connection-flood attribution.

entries.description: ASA failover-pair and multiple-context triage — detect split-brain before forcing a failover, config-sync direction, context-scoped commands from the right prompt
entries.notes: TG-85 (epic TG-78): newly authored, vendor-doc-grounded content, not predecessor-derived. entries.description: Proxmox node disk/storage triage — a degraded ZFS mirror is survivable; never remote-revive a wedged controller or reboot the host, plus the latent boot-loader and PCI-passthrough recovery traps
entries.notes: Distilled from a real SEV-1 postmortem: a remote sysfs/PCIe 'revive' of a wedged NVMe controller hung a serving hypervisor and took every guest down for 11h. All estate specifics (hostnames, drive serials, guest names, ticket ids, timestamps) stripped; kept the transferable failure mode + the two latent recovery traps (unsynced ESP across the mirror, address-pinned vfio-pci passthrough surviving a bus renumber).

entries.description: Proxmox cluster-plane triage — tell a benign member-count alarm from a pmxcfs wedge (high load, idle CPU, D-state) from a real quorum fault; restart pve-cluster, never reboot, to clear a wedge
entries.notes: Distilled from two real incidents: a pmxcfs FUSE-fs wedge that read as CPU saturation (load ~163 on idle cores = D-state pile-up; cleared by 'systemctl restart pve-cluster' with no guest impact, where a reboot drops every guest and pvestatd-alone stays wedged), and a cororings member-count monitor firing after a node was added (a threshold-config alarm). Estate specifics stripped.

entries.description: Proxmox guest-lifecycle triage — a stopped guest whose node and storage are healthy is a reversible start candidate; node-first, storage-first on a failed start, host-down is a node fault
entries.notes: Distilled from the estate's guest-down precedent and host-recovery autostart behaviour: node-health-FIRST, storage-first on a failed start, no host action to recover a guest, no single reboot op-class. Estate specifics stripped.

entries.description: WAN/ISP uplink triage — a line-up-but-no-IP uplink is a session/ISP fault upstream of the router (never restart downstream victims); two ISPs are not redundancy without verified failover parity
entries.notes: Distilled from a real 6h47m P1: a PPPoE session died (the modem/ONT stopped answering discovery) while the WAN interface stayed physically UP with no IP — total internet + cross-site VPN + tenant loss. The backup ISP was online but lacked crypto-map/NAT parity, so it could not auto-compensate (the SPOF behind 'two ISPs'). Recovery = the primary's session re-establishing (first traffic build via it), not the interface coming up. All estate specifics (ISP names, IPs, interface names, ONT model, tenant/hostnames) stripped.
